mapper.select: SELECT * FROM family WHERE invite_code = #{inviteCode} AND invite_enabled = 1 AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY invite_code_expire_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM family WHERE invite_code = #{inviteCode} AND deleted = 0 AND invite_code_expire_at > NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE family SET invite_enabled = 0, invite_code = NULL, invite_code_expire_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND invite_code = #{inviteCode} AND invite_enabled = 1 AND deleted = 0
UPDATE family SET invite_enabled = 0, invite_code = NULL, invite_code_expire_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE family SET deleted = 1, deleted_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM family WHERE deleted = 1 AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at <= #{cutoff} ORDER BY deleted_at LIMIT 50
